Casey (Marketing): Quick sync — we need a field-ready 1-pager 'Differentiator Snackpack' for sales: top 3 claims vs cloud AI platforms, vs LLM APIs, vs infra vendors. Draft doc: https://docs.google.com/xxx. Need: 1 pager, 90s talking points, and inbound routing rules. Who can take first pass?
Priya (PMM): I can take first pass. I'll focus on claims + supporting proof points. timeline ok?
Jamal (Sales Eng): Awesome. Can we include a short 'what to ask' checklist for discovery? customers often ask about SLA, determinism, and multi-region failover.
Evan (Bench): I have a fresh latency/cost table from last week's test (gpt-fast-8k vs redwood-quant-4b). I'll paste numbers into the doc. TL;DR: 20–30% lower p95 latency on average under our batching.
Ava (Content): For the 90s talking points, keep it: Problem, Redwood approach, Example customer outcome. I'll write the lead magnet headline.
Riley (Solutions): For routing: anything with security/air-gapped mention -> private path; high-QPS POCs -> dedicated; otherwise hosted. Also add a canned response for @sales leads that asks for SLA/price.
Casey (Marketing): Nice. Riley, can you throw me the canned routing snippet here? Put it in `code` so Sales can copy.
Riley (Solutions): ```Inbound routing rules:
- tag: security: any mention of 'on-prem', 'air-gapped', 'VPC', 'HSM' -> route to solutions@ and trigger Private track
- tag: high-qps: 'throughput', 'sustained', 'p95 < 200ms' -> route to dedicated-team and start pricing template
- tag: benchmark: 'bench', 'latency test', 'open model' -> route to eng-bench and attach benchmark pack
- default: hosted-interested -> guide to hosted trial + self-serve pricing
``` 
Priya (PMM): Love this. Evan — when you drop numbers, can you also add confidence intervals and test conditions? Sales will ask.
Evan (Bench): Yep. I'll add `methodology.md` section.
reminder-bot: Reminder: Marketing sync in 30 minutes for this thread :spiral_calendar: (set by Casey)
Casey (Marketing): Goal for this thread: PR-ready one-pager + sales copy + routing rules by EOD Thurs. Owners: Priya (one-pager), Evan (bench data), Riley (routing), Ava (90s). Ping @sales for review when ready.
Priya (PMM): On it. I'll post first draft by 5pm tomorrow. :+1:
Jamal (Sales Eng): Will review and add 'what to ask' checklist. Quick Q — do we want a short competitor matrix (price/latency/SLA) or risk oversimplifying?
Ava (Content): Keep matrix simple — 3 rows (cloud AI, LLM APIs, infra vendors) and 3 columns (latency/cost/reliability). We can link to detailed appendix.
Casey (Marketing): Agreed. Keep public doc light; appendices for reps.
Priya (PMM): tagging this doc: #snackpack-diff-v1
Casey (Marketing): Perfect. Thanks team. :fire:
